points.K8: 物理屏障就是防护装置
points.K9: 事故主因：防护缺失损坏
points.K10: 防护的目的是隔开人和危险
points.S3: 防卷入：束发、不戴手套碰旋转件
points.S5: 设备操作位的工效设计
points.S6: 国内机械安全标准与设备管理

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台带透明防护罩的设备旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a machine with a clear protective cover and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天用十道题，认识机械防护。

shots.scene: 一行图标：齿轮、皮带轮、防护罩、锁
shots.prompt_en: A row of simple icons: a gear, a belt pulley, a protective cover and a padlock. No people.
shots.narration: 转动的部件，要用防护罩隔开。

shots.scene: 实验室角落一台真空泵，皮带罩放在地上，皮带裸露
shots.prompt_en: In a lab corner, a vacuum pump runs with its belt exposed; the belt cover lies on the floor beside it.
shots.narration: 实验室的真空泵，皮带罩拆下没装回。

shots.scene: 阿杰弯腰伸手想去捡泵旁的螺丝
shots.prompt_en: The young male student bends down and reaches toward a screw near the running belt.
shots.narration: 阿杰伸手去捡泵边的螺丝。

shots.scene: 小研一把拉住他
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student quickly pulls the young male student back by the arm.
shots.narration: 小研一把拉住他：皮带还在转！

shots.scene: 老李赶来，看着拆下的罩子摇头
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer arrives and shakes his head at the removed cover.
shots.narration: 老李说：咱们把机械防护好好学一遍。

shots.scene: 皮带轮、齿轮和飞出碎片三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a pulley with a hand nearby, two meshing gears, and a flying fragment toward an eye. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：运动部件会造成哪些伤害？

shots.scene: 手指被挤压的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of fingers being squeezed between two parts. No people.
shots.narration: 挤压手指和手，

shots.scene: 两个齿轮之间的咬入点闪红
shots.prompt_en: The nip point between two meshing gears flashes red. No people.
shots.narration: 身体被卷进运动部件之间，

shots.scene: 碎片飞向眼睛，护目镜挡住
shots.prompt_en: A small fragment flies toward an eye icon and is stopped by safety goggles. No people.
shots.narration: 飞出物伤眼，答案是以上都有。

shots.scene: 老李给阿杰和小研讲解设备防护罩
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer explains a machine's protective cover to the young male student and the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 第二题：防护装置要培训什么？

shots.scene: 防护罩和问号、灯泡图标
shots.prompt_en: A protective cover icon with a question mark and a light bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 怎么用，为什么必须用，

shots.scene: 防护罩被打开，旁边锁和时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: A protective cover shown open, with a padlock icon and a clock icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 什么时候才允许拆，

shots.scene: 扳手交给持证人员的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a wrench handed only to a person with a badge. No people.
shots.narration: 怎么拆、谁有权拆，都要学。

shots.scene: 四张卡片：固定罩、警示带、联锁门、可调罩
shots.prompt_en: Four cards: a fixed cover, a striped barrier tape, an interlocked door and an adjustable cover. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：哪个不是机械防护装置？

shots.scene: 警示带卡片打红叉
shots.prompt_en: The striped barrier tape card is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 答案是隔离警示带。

shots.scene: 手从警示带下面伸过去碰到皮带的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand reaching under a barrier tape toward a moving belt. No people.
shots.narration: 它只是提醒，挡不住伸进去的手。

shots.scene: 老李准备打开真空泵的防护罩维修
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer prepares to open the protective cover of the vacuum pump for repair.
shots.narration: 第四题：拆罩维修前先做什么？

shots.scene: 警示带、提示牌、广播三个图标打问号
shots.prompt_en: Icons of barrier tape, a caution sign and a speaker, each with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 拉警示带、挂提示、告诉别人，都不够。

shots.scene: 插头拔下，开关上锁挂牌
shots.prompt_en: The plug is pulled out and the switch is locked with a padlock and a blank tag. No people.
shots.narration: 答案是上锁挂牌，切断并隔离能量。

shots.scene: 老李确认按开关无反应
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses the start button to confirm the pump does not start.
shots.narration: 试一下确认不能启动，再动手。

shots.scene: 四个防护图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four guard icons in a row: a bolted fixed cover, a door with a switch, a sliding adjustable cover and a spring cover that moves with the work. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：常见的防护装置有几类？

shots.scene: 固定罩用螺丝拧紧
shots.prompt_en: A fixed cover held by screws that need a tool to open. No people.
shots.narration: 固定式：要用工具才能拆。

shots.scene: 联锁门一开，机器停止
shots.prompt_en: An interlocked door opens and the machine stops at once. No people.
shots.narration: 联锁式：门一开，机器就停。

shots.scene: 可调罩和随工件移动的自调罩
shots.prompt_en: An adjustable cover set by hand beside a self-adjusting cover that lifts with the workpiece. No people.
shots.narration: 可调式手动调整，自调式随工件动。

shots.scene: 一本书和图章图标
shots.prompt_en: A closed blank book with a stamp icon. No people.
shots.narration: 原题答四类，分类按国家标准。

shots.scene: 坚固的金属防护罩
shots.prompt_en: A sturdy metal protective cover on a machine. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：防护装置该是什么样？

shots.scene: 罩子用螺栓牢牢固定在机身上
shots.prompt_en: The cover is bolted firmly to the machine frame. No people.
shots.narration: 结实，牢牢固定在机器上，

shots.scene: 罩子把转动部件全部包住
shots.prompt_en: The cover completely encloses all moving parts. No people.
shots.narration: 把运动部件完全罩住，三样都要。

shots.scene: 四张卡片：开口、随手拆、新危险、易碎
shots.prompt_en: Four cards: a cover with a big opening, a cover easily lifted off, a warning triangle and a cracked cover. No people.
shots.narration: 第七题：防护装置必须做到什么？

shots.scene: 罩子边缘锋利划手的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a sharp cover edge cutting a hand. No people.
shots.narration: 答案是不能带来新的危害。

shots.scene: 大开口、易拆、易碎三张卡片打红叉
shots.prompt_en: The big opening, easy removal and cracked cover cards are crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 留大口子、随手可拆、一碰就碎，都不行。

shots.section_title: 物理屏障就是防护装置
shots.scene: 人和转动部件之间出现一道透明墙
shots.prompt_en: A clear wall appears between a person icon and a rotating part. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：谁给运动部件提供物理屏障？
overlay: 物理屏障就是防护装置

shots.section_title: 物理屏障就是防护装置
shots.scene: 制度书、操作手册打叉，防护罩打勾
shots.prompt_en: A rule book and a manual are crossed out, while a protective cover gets a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 不是制度和操作规定，是防护装置。

shots.section_title: 事故主因：防护缺失损坏
shots.scene: 机械事故现场图标：缺失的防护罩
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a machine with its guard missing and a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：机械事故的主要原因？
overlay: 事故主因：防护缺失损坏

shots.section_title: 事故主因：防护缺失损坏
shots.scene: 防护罩缺失卡片亮红
shots.prompt_en: A card showing a missing guard glows red. No people.
shots.narration: 答案是防护装置缺失或损坏。

shots.section_title: 事故主因：防护缺失损坏
shots.scene: 检查表和扫帚图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank inspection checklist icon and a broom icon. No people.
shots.narration: 缺检查、缺维护，也会让防护失效。

shots.section_title: 防护的目的是隔开人和危险
shots.scene: 欣欣站在防护罩前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a protective cover on a machine.
shots.narration: 第十题：机械防护的目的是什么？
overlay: 防护的目的是隔开人和危险

shots.section_title: 防护的目的是隔开人和危险
shots.scene: 防止机器损坏的卡片打叉
shots.prompt_en: A card about preventing machine breakdown is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不是为了保护机器不坏，

shots.section_title: 防护的目的是隔开人和危险
shots.scene: 人和运动部件被屏障隔开，打勾
shots.prompt_en: A barrier separates a person icon from moving parts, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 而是在人和危险之间设屏障。

shots.scene: 实验室里离心机、磁力搅拌器、摇床、真空泵排成一排
shots.prompt_en: A row of lab equipment: a centrifuge, a magnetic stirrer, a shaker and a vacuum pump. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里也有很多运动部件。

shots.scene: 老李把皮带罩装回真空泵
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer fits the belt cover back onto the vacuum pump.
shots.narration: 皮带、联轴器的罩子，拆了必须装回。

shots.scene: 小研检查摇床上的瓶子夹紧
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks that flasks are clamped firmly on a shaker.
shots.narration: 摇床上的容器要夹紧，防止甩出。

shots.scene: 小研把对称位置的离心管放好
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student places tubes in opposite positions of a centrifuge rotor.
shots.narration: 离心机要对称配平。

shots.scene: 离心机盖子锁住，指示灯亮
shots.prompt_en: The centrifuge lid is locked and an indicator light glows. No people.
shots.narration: 盖子锁好，联锁起作用才能运转。

shots.scene: 转子还在转时开盖的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of opening the lid while the rotor still spins, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 完全停稳再开盖，不用手去刹。

shots.scene: 离心机发出异响，小研按下停止
shots.prompt_en: The centrifuge shakes and the female graduate student presses the stop button.
shots.narration: 异响抖动，立即停机报告。

shots.section_title: 防卷入：束发、不戴手套碰旋转件
shots.scene: 阿杰的长发和松垮袖口靠近摇床
shots.prompt_en: Loose long hair and a loose sleeve hang near a rotating shaker. No people.
shots.narration: 长发、宽松衣袖，容易被卷进去。
overlay: 防卷入：束发、不戴手套碰旋转件

shots.section_title: 防卷入：束发、不戴手套碰旋转件
shots.scene: 小研把头发束起，袖口扎紧
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student ties back her hair and fastens her sleeve cuffs.
shots.narration: 头发束起，袖口扎紧，摘下挂绳。

shots.section_title: 防卷入：束发、不戴手套碰旋转件
shots.scene: 戴手套伸向旋转的钻头，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a gloved hand reaching toward a spinning drill, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 靠近旋转部件，不要戴手套去碰。

shots.scene: 设备上的红色蘑菇头急停按钮
shots.prompt_en: A red mushroom-head emergency stop button on a machine. No people.
shots.narration: 开机前，先找到急停按钮。

shots.scene: 阿杰拍下急停按钮，机器停止
shots.prompt_en: The young male student slaps the emergency stop button and the machine stops.
shots.narration: 出现危险，立即拍下急停。

shots.scene: 急停按钮前堆着纸箱，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Boxes piled in front of an emergency stop button, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 急停前不能堆放杂物。

shots.scene: 老李检查原因后才旋开复位
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks the machine before twisting the emergency stop to reset it.
shots.narration: 查清原因，再复位开机。

shots.section_title: 设备操作位的工效设计
shots.scene: 阿杰踮脚够高处的控制面板，腰部弯曲
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stretches on tiptoe to reach a high control panel; his back is bent.
shots.narration: 控制按钮太高太远，操作很别扭。
overlay: 设备操作位的工效设计

shots.section_title: 设备操作位的工效设计
shots.scene: 调整后控制面板在手肘高度，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The control panel is moved to elbow height in front of the young male student; a green check appears.
shots.narration: 常用按钮放在手边，台面高度合适。

shots.section_title: 设备操作位的工效设计
shots.scene: 小研反复手动装卸样品，手腕红点
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student loads samples by hand again and again; her wrist glows red.
shots.narration: 反复装卸样品，手腕容易劳损。

shots.section_title: 设备操作位的工效设计
shots.scene: 使用辅助工具和轮换
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student uses a loading tool, then hands over to the young male student in turn.
shots.narration: 用辅助工具，和同学轮换着做。

shots.section_title: 国内机械安全标准与设备管理
shots.scene: 欣欣站在一摞标准书前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands next to a stack of closed blank standard books.
shots.narration: 国内有机械安全系列国家标准。
overlay: 国内机械安全标准与设备管理

shots.section_title: 国内机械安全标准与设备管理
shots.scene: 设备档案和定期检查表
shots.prompt_en: A blank equipment record folder and a periodic inspection checklist. No people.
shots.narration: 设备要建档，防护装置定期检查。

shots.section_title: 国内机械安全标准与设备管理
shots.scene: 王老师在实验室检查表上打勾
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator ticks a blank lab inspection form beside a machine.
shots.narration: 安全设施不得擅自拆除和停用。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，白板上齿轮、防护罩、锁图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a whiteboard with icons of a gear, a protective cover and a padlock.
shots.narration: 运动部件会挤压、卷入、飞出。

shots.scene: 固定罩、联锁门图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fixed cover and an interlocked door with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 防护装置要牢、要全，不添新危害。

shots.scene: 上锁挂牌和急停按钮图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a lockout padlock and an emergency stop button. No people.
shots.narration: 拆罩维修先上锁，危险时拍急停。

shots.scene: 束发、离心机配平图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of tied-back hair and a balanced centrifuge rotor. No people.
shots.narration: 束发扎袖，离心机配平锁盖。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别，身后真空泵装好了皮带罩
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a vacuum pump with its belt cover back in place.
shots.narration: 罩子装回去，安全转起来！
